每按一次“排队提示”，它将返回越来越可读的二维码！

安装和依赖

该存档包含两个工作流程：

QR_Base_NoCycles

QR_Base_NoCycles是一次性生成二维码的传统工作流程。它经过了微调，但无论如何可能需要反复试验。

  1. 安装舒适QR自定义节点；

  2. 下载ControlNet QR 图案并将其放入“/模型/ControlNet“ 文件夹；

  3. 下载猫潜伏亮度模型并将其放入“/模型/ControlNet“ 文件夹；

  4. （推荐）下载祝福2VAE 并将其放入“/模型/vae“ 文件夹；

  5. （推荐）安装WAS 节点套件自定义节点；

  6. （推荐）安装化装舞会自定义节点；

  7. （可选）安装阿洛尔自定义节点。

没有 WAS 和 Masquerade 也是可以的，但你必须删除“纠错”组。

Allor是一个非常重的插件（90+节点），你可以跳过它，只是快捷方式图像过滤节点（用于圆角）。

QR_周期

QR_周期是一个改进的工作流程，开始生成几乎难以阅读的二维码，但每次按下时都会应用越来越严格的条件“排队提示".

  1. 要求与QR_base_NoCycles工作流程；

  2. 安装骑自行车的人自定义节点；

  3. （可选）安装ComfyQR 扫描节点.

如何使用

  1. 输入二维码文本。

  2. 选择型号。

  3. 写提示。提及容易破碎的细节：马赛克、波浪、树叶等。

  4. （可选）为角落里的大方块编写关键字，例如：“（盒子、树枝、石头：0.6）”。重量必须减半。将提示符连接到最近的 ControlNet 节点。

  5. 按“排队提示”。最有可能的是，第一个结果不可读。

  6. 用手机扫描结果。如果不可读，请再次排队提示。以后的每一个结果都会更好！这将需要 1 到 5 次迭代。

  7. 当结果足够好时，按“新循环”！否则，工作流程将继续提高可读性，覆盖您的结果！

如果您使用自动扫描（见下文），则无需担心按“新周期”，它会自动更新。当您恐慌取消队列时，它也会更新。

扫描

方法一：电话

您的手机浏览器很可能可以扫描二维码。点击地址栏并查找 QR 图标。

顺便说一句，您可以将手机固定在某个支架上，朝向显示器。

方法二：自动

此工作流程可以自动检测 QR 并在可读时停止！

  1. 取消静音”测试 QR 停止” 组；

  2. 检查“额外选项” 和 “自动排队” 在 ComfyUI 菜单中。

  3. 按“排队提示".

这样，生成过程将自动重复，直到 QR 码可读。

问题是，它依赖于兹巴图书馆，它非常过时。只有在以下情况下才会成功读取 QR：非常可读。安装起来也可能很棘手，你可能必须搜索最好的 python 实现（皮兹巴尔? 兹巴莱特？）。可能还需要MVSC安装。此安装指南可能会有所帮助（未尝试）：在 Windows 上安装 zbarlight.

资源

型号：无法预测模型在制作二维码时的表现如何。但我的建议是：

  • 动漫模型（仅限动漫, 阿尼波)

  • 高对比度卡通模型（迪士尼皮克斯, 卡通游)

VAE：由于某种原因，祝福2VAE 极大地提高了可扫描性。

注释

  • 如果第一次尝试的结果太好，请降低“开始迭代" 为零（左下节点）。

  • 不包括面部细节器。我假设您已经有了自己最喜欢的面部改善工作流程。

  • 方角的关键词将不可避免地渗透到整个画面中。保持他们的体重较低。

(check v1.0 page for more scannable QR code images)

Each time you press "Queue Prompt", it will return more and more readable QR!

Installation and dependencies

The archive contains two workflows:

QR_Base_NoCycles

QR_Base_NoCyclesis a traditional workflow to generate QR Code in one go. It's fine-tuned, but may require trial-and-error anyway.

  1. InstallComfyQRcustom nodes;

  2. DownloadControlNet QR Patternand put it in "/models/ControlNet" folder;

  3. DownloadLatent Cat Brightnessmodel and put it in "/models/ControlNet" folder;

  4. (recommended) Downloadblessed2VAE and put it in "/models/vae" folder;

  5. (recommended) InstallWAS Node Suitecustom nodes;

  6. (recommended) InstallMasqueradecustom nodes;

  7. (optional) InstallAllorcustom nodes.

It is possible to go without WAS and Masquerade, but you'd have to delete "Error Correction" group.

Allor is a very heavy plugin (90+ nodes), and you can skip it, just shortcutImageFilterNode(it's for rounding corners).

QR_Cycles

QR_Cyclesis an improved workflow that starts generating a barely readable QR, but applies more and more strict conditions every time you press "Queue Prompt".

  1. Same requirenments as theQR_base_NoCyclesworkflow;

  2. InstallCyclistcustom nodes;

  3. (optional) InstallComfyQR-scanning-nodes.

How to use

  1. Input QR Code text.

  2. Select model.

  3. Write prompt. Mention details which tend to fragment: mosaic, waves, leaves, etc.

  4. (optional) Write keywords for big squares in corners, example: "(box, tree branch, stone:0.6)". Weights must be halved. Connect prompt to nearest ControlNet node.

  5. Press "Queue prompt". Most likely, first result will not be readable.

  6. Scan the result with your phone. If not readable, queue prompt again. Each subsequent result will be better! It will take from 1 to 5 iterations.

  7. Press "New Cycle" when result is good enough! Otherwise, workflow will continue to improve readability, overwriting your result!

If you go with automatic scanning (see below), you don't need to worry about pressing "New Cycle", it updates automatically. It also updates when you cancel the queue in panic.

Scanning

Method 1: Phone

Most likely, your phone browser can scan QR Codes. Tap on an address bar and look for QR icon.

By the way, you can attach your phone to some stand, directed towards monitor.

Method 2: Automatic

It is possible for this workflow to automatically detect QR and stop when it's readable!

  1. Unmute "Test QR to Stop" group;

  2. Check "Extra Options" and "Auto Queue" in ComfyUI menu.

  3. Press "Queue Prompt".

This way, generation will automatically repeat itself until QR Code is readable.

The problem is, it relies onzbarlibrary, which is incredibly outdated. It will successfully read QR only when it'sveryreadable. It might also be tricky to install, you might have to search for the best python implementation (pyzbar? zbarlight?). It might also requireMVSCinstallation. This installation guide might help (didn't try):Install zbarlight on Windows.

Resources

Model:It's unpredictable to say how model will perform at making QR Codes. But my recommendations are:

  • Anime models (OnlyAnime, Aniwave)

  • High contast cartoonish models (DisneyPixar, ToonYou)

VAE:For some reason,blessed2VAE greatly improves scannability.

Notes

  • If result is too good first try, lower "Starting Iteration" to zero (bottom left node).

  • Face detailer is not included. I assume you already have your favourite workflow to improve faces.

  • Keywords for square corners will inevitably bleed to the whole picture. Keep theirs weights low.

Check out my other workflows.
